text:
Tess: Daily async — quick sync for launch assets + bench posts. What I did: drafted benchmark writeup, coordinated copy for hero, prepped social snippets. Blockers: still waiting on final hero image and CDN path for landing page. Today: merge PR, kick off a 5% canary, publish bench post once Ben confirms p50/p95.

Sam: Uploaded hero assets to GDrive: https://drive.google.com/launch-assets (file: hero_launch_v3.png, 1600x900). Added alt text + recommended crop. :white_check_mark: Also dropped the short social copy in the doc.

Ben: I can review the PR (#432) this morning. Quick ask — what's the CDN domain we want to use for the image? Need to set correct caching headers. Also found an embedding pipeline small regression — opened issue #987. Not blocking launch but worth noting.

Tess: CDN should be cdn.redwood-inference.com — will that work? @Ben can you also verify cache-control? If so I'll point the landing image URL to that.

Ben: Yep cdn.redwood-inference.com is fine. I'll add `Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400` to the asset config. Reviewing PR now, plan to push a tiny change for the canary flag.

Natalie: Rollout window we agreed on is today 10:00–11:00 PDT. Recommend 5% canary for first 30m, then 25% for another 15m if no regressions. Launch-bot will handle shifts. Need sign-off on benchmarks to publish with the post.

Tess: Canary plan sounds good. @Sam can you make sure the bench post includes a one-line summary for social (e.g., "p50 down 12% vs baseline") so marketing can schedule posts?

Sam: Done — added table and one-paragraph summary in the doc. Link: https://docs.google.com/benchmarks-launch. Will add the p50/p95 numbers once Ben posts them.

Ben: Posting quick numbers here: staging p50=78ms, p95=210ms (payload size ~1.2KB). I'll run one more pass by 9:15 and update PR.

Tess: Awesome — if Ben's numbers hold I'll merge PR at ~9:45 and tag release. A few quick ops notes: use this curl to smoke test after canary kicks: `curl -I https://staging.redwood.com/launch -H "Accept: application/json"`.

launch-bot: launch-bot: Canary scheduled for 10:00 PDT at 5%. Auto-rollback threshold set to 0.5% error rate.

Ben: Merged the canary flag change to PR #432. Running final smoke locally, then will approve. Also added a short note in issue #987 about a potential tokenization mismatch that caused the embed diff.

Natalie: Thanks — I approve the go-ahead if we keep the canary thresholds. Marketing will have the bench post queued once Ben confirms final numbers.

Tess: Thanks everyone. Plan: merge 9:45, canary 10:00, monitor for 30m. Ping here if anything odd. :rocket:

Ben: LGTM.

Sam: Got it, will schedule the social posts after the 10:30 checkpoint.

Natalie: Signed off.

Tess: Closing the loop — hero image live on CDN once PR is merged. Will share final published links here.
